title: Supabase product bento
description: A bento of white, hairline-bordered 16px cards in a 4-column grid, two rows 400px tall: a wide first card with grey copy, ink-stressed words and a checked list beside its illustration, then six single cards with text on top and an illustration filling the lower half. A soft shadow appears on hover. Below, a 22px two-tone summary line. Phones get a plain stack of compact text cards without illustrations.
notes: illustration slots show only from lg up, as on the original; empty slots are soft grey placeholders
has no top padding: it is meant to sit right under the hero
